description:
“I’ll offer you my virginity. So please… make me a real Countess.” 

Countess Luana, cast aside by her husband and denied even their wedding night, becomes the target of gossip and ridicule from everyone around her. Then comes a sweet, dangerous temptation— the great demon Astaroth offers to grant her deepest wish if she surrenders her virginity to him.

 “Give your virginity to me. Then I’ll make you the true Countess you long to be.”

 After a sinful night and a dark contract with the demon, Luana finally gains her husband’s love and earns the recognition of everyone as the Countess. Yet she can’t stop thinking about the nights she spent with Astaroth…
